step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram shows an IoT data pipeline for a circular supply chain blockchain solution. IoT Core receives telemetry data from farm sensors and passes it to Lambda. Lambda calls an Application Load Balancer (ALB) which routes transactions to Hyperledger Fabric smart contracts running on an Amazon EKS cluster (labeled BLOCKCHAIN). When transactions are written, off-chain data is synced to DynamoDB, which streams/loads data into Amazon S3, and finally feeds SageMaker for predictive analytics models. For events requiring immediate action, the EKS smart contract invokes SNS notifications sent to end users/drivers. EKS is monitored via CloudWatch and integrates with CloudHSM (labeled KEYS) for key management.
